scoring: Each correctness item: 0 absent/wrong, 5 partial or claim unsupported by implementation, 10 fulfilled. Other components use listed anchors; do not reward verbosity or unnecessary code. Hard failures from original preregistered plan override scores. This refinement does not replace the preregistered task or add a hard failure.

E01: Public ticket excludes labels and split metadata; disclose process/file isolation limits
Keep related customers/paraphrases in one split
Adapter exercises handle_ticket with tools and state; distinguish demo from missing real app
Report 2/3 completion, timeout and conditional score separately; no migration-quality claim
E02: Correctness and evidence replace confidence/verbosity as scoring rule
Recompute agreement against supplied human labels
Do not misdiagnose order bias: b wins both given orders; test permutations
Test correct/incorrect near misses, length and injection; scope local calibration claims
E03: Specify/reproduce rescore of both sides under a fixed validated grader, without inventing unavailable outputs
Distinguish 60 observations, 2 related cases and 1 independent group
Do not infer significance/generalization from repetitions or aggregate counts
E04: Reject candidate with unauthorized refunds regardless of mean quality
Enforce authenticated ownership AND duplicate verification
Relabel repeatedly selected test as validation
Freeze candidate and measurement before genuinely new final evaluation; do not reuse exposed cases
E05: Cached/reasoning counts are subsets; successful application cost is .0039
Include failed application .001 and judge .002; known subtotal .0069
Unknown judge timeout cost remains unknown and prevents total-cost claim
Require measured quality noninferiority, at least 15% full cost saving and verified mechanism; point means insufficient
E06: Do not combine isolated savings into measured joint saving or adopt now
Complete model/effort sweep; optimize prompt at fixed model then re-probe lower-cost configurations
Evaluate routing on representative full traffic and rebuild generated memory with unchanged control
Jointly confirm frozen combination and use untouched test only after selection
G01: Preserve incident-derived payment check and no-duplicate rule
Replace obsolete no-tools claim with actual available-tool contract
Preserve RESULT prefix or update coupled consumer with regression evidence
Make minimal justified change to unsupported three-sentence restriction and distinguish static from model validation
G02: Preserve all structured output items and opaque payloads for continuation
Separate commentary, final text and pending function calls
Handle incomplete status and preserve usage/failure information
Identify affected parser/history/tool ledger contracts; distinguish fixture from actual SDK/service validation
G03: Locate first bad transformation between prior output and next request
Choose one history owner and avoid previous_response_id plus full history duplication
Preserve phase and pair tool output with actual c1 call; reject unknown correspondence
Preserve compaction item exactly and verify continuation without fabricated service results
G04: Partial text without terminal event is not success
Match batch by custom_id, preserve requested ordering if needed
Retain b error and missing c explicitly
Preserve available usage and distinguish terminal failure/incomplete from completed
G05: Persist scoped operation identity and pending state before remote mutation
Reconcile uncertain remote outcome with stable idempotency key before replay
Validate authorization and enforce bounded attempts/budget/cancellation
Test crash after remote success and duplicates; avoid exactly-once claims from local transaction
G06: Verify webhook before mutation and deduplicate replayed events
Separate durable session/work from replaceable environment; no blind re-provision
Enforce memory tenant and expiry and cancellation before new effects
Handle recovery, cleanup and verified completion; disconnect/idle are not task success

anchors.10: Partial reproducible evidence; critical implementation requested but missing
anchors.15: Task-appropriate inspectable artifact or code with material verification gaps
anchors.20: Reproducible task-appropriate evidence with one minor gap
anchors.25: Reproduced evidence covers requested behavior; mocks and missing external evidence explicit

anchors.5: Addresses one of several supplied mechanisms
anchors.10: Addresses most but leaves a material path unsafe or misleading
anchors.15: All main supplied failures addressed with one coverage gap
anchors.20: All supplied failures handled and conclusions appropriately bounded

anchors.0: Cannot operate result or requires unauthorized work
anchors.5: Substantial avoidable setup or incomplete execution path
anchors.10: Usable with documented limitations or modest unnecessary complexity
anchors.15: Clear bounded local execution/reproduction, minimal dependencies appropriate to task

review_limits: Author-selected synthetic failure tasks, not an independent representative sample
Reviewer is the implementing root agent; neutral run IDs do not provide strict reviewer blinding
One stochastic execution per skill and task; paired score differences are descriptive, not population estimates
Package names and shared installed skill catalog remain visible; protocol isolation is not a security boundary
